title: A realm's code from the browser, on the dev server only v1 (realm.code.v1)
about: What the editor shell on a page the dev server serves asks that server, and what it answers (GitHub #13421): the realm's own source files, one file's text, and a save that is answered with the compiler's check. Only coax/web/serve.c while it watches answers it; --static, the API and the realm origin have no such route. A path is the page's own realm source or it is refused.
lines: realm.code.v1 save PAGE PATH BYTES, a line end, then BYTES bytes of text
realm.code.v1 files PAGE N, then N lines: f PATH BYTES
realm.code.v1 file PATH BYTES, a line end, then BYTES bytes of text
realm.code.v1 errors PATH BYTES, a line end, then BYTES bytes of the compiler's words
